entries.title: Job 39:1
segments: ¶"Do you know the time when the wild mountain goats bear young? [Or] can you mark when the deer gives birth?

entries.title: Job 39:2
segments: Can you number the months [that] they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they bear young?

entries.title: Job 39:3
segments: They bow down, They bring forth their young, They deliver their offspring.

entries.title: Job 39:4
segments: Their young ones are healthy, They grow strong with grain; They depart and do not return to them.

entries.title: Job 39:5
segments: "Who set the wild donkey free? Who loosed the bonds of the onager,

entries.title: Job 39:6
segments: Whose home I have made the wilderness, And the barren land his dwelling?

entries.title: Job 39:7
segments: He scorns the tumult of the city; He does not heed the shouts of the driver.

entries.title: Job 39:8
segments: The range of the mountains [is] his pasture, And he searches after every green thing.

entries.title: Job 39:9
segments: "Will the wild ox be willing to serve you? Will he bed by your manger?

entries.title: Job 39:10
segments: Can you bind the wild ox in the furrow with ropes? Or will he plow the valleys behind you?

entries.title: Job 39:11
segments: Will you trust him because his strength [is] great? Or will you leave your labor to him?

entries.title: Job 39:12
segments: Will you trust him to bring home your grain, And gather it to your threshing floor?

entries.title: Job 39:13
segments: ¶"The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, But are her wings and pinions [like the] kindly stork's?

entries.title: Job 39:14
segments: For she leaves her eggs on the ground, And warms them in the dust;

entries.title: Job 39:15
segments: She forgets that a foot may crush them, Or that a wild beast may break them.

entries.title: Job 39:16
segments: She treats her young harshly, as though [they were] not hers; Her labor is in vain, without concern,

entries.title: Job 39:17
segments: Because God deprived her of wisdom, And did not endow her with understanding.

entries.title: Job 39:18
segments: When she lifts herself on high, She scorns the horse and its rider.

entries.title: Job 39:19
segments: ¶"Have you given the horse strength? Have you clothed his neck with thunder?

entries.title: Job 39:20
segments: Can you frighten him like a locust? His majestic snorting strikes terror.

entries.title: Job 39:21
segments: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in [his] strength; He gallops into the clash of arms.

entries.title: Job 39:22
segments: He mocks at fear, and is not frightened; Nor does he turn back from the sword.

entries.title: Job 39:23
segments: The quiver rattles against him, The glittering spear and javelin.

entries.title: Job 39:24
segments: He devours the distance with fierceness and rage; Nor does he come to a halt because the trumpet [has] sounded.

entries.title: Job 39:25
segments: At the [blast of] the trumpet he says, 'Aha!' He smells the battle from afar, The thunder of captains and shouting.

entries.title: Job 39:26
segments: ¶"Does the hawk fly by your wisdom, [And] spread its wings toward the south?

entries.title: Job 39:27
segments: Does the eagle mount up at your command, And make its nest on high?

entries.title: Job 39:28
segments: On the rocks it dwells and resides, On the crag of the rock and the stronghold.

entries.title: Job 39:29
segments: From there it spies out the prey; Its eyes observe from afar.

entries.title: Job 39:30
segments: Its young ones suck up blood; And where the slain [are], there it [is]."
